how.title: How it works
how.1x: Create your account and answer a few questions: what you offer, who your customers are, your current offers and the style you like. You also choose your package there.
how.2x: We study your business and your competitors, then create your brand identity, posts and captions to match what you told us.
how.3x: Everything arrives in your account, with revision rounds included. Nothing is published before you approve it.
faq.title: Clear answers
faq.1q: What do you need from me?
faq.1a1: Create your account and tell us about your business. Before we start, and before you pay, we need: your logo, at least one of your Instagram, Facebook or TikTok accounts with its username, your goal, who your customers are, and your country. We also ask what you offer, your city, your current offers and the style you like.
faq.1a2: For the posts themselves we need real photos. For a shop, a café or another place people visit: 10 photos of your business, or 6 of your products, each with a photo and its price. For an app, a website or a service: at least 4 screens of your own app or website; we capture them from your site, or you upload a few. Each month we also ask for last month's numbers, if you have them. We never put stock photos of strangers in your posts.
faq.2a1: We do. Once you approve a post, we publish it on your pages on its date and reply to comments and messages. Nothing is published before you approve it.
faq.4q: Who owns the designs you make for me?
faq.4a1: The designs, captions and Brand Deck files we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours, and we do not show work made for you in public without your written approval.
faq.5a1: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. We deliver the designs and the content calendar described on the pricing page. Results depend on your business, your market and how you use them.
faq.7q: Which languages do you work in?
faq.7a1: This site is in English and Arabic, and you can write to us in either. Your posts and captions can be in Arabic, English or both. The Brand Deck can be made in English, Arabic or both.
faq.9a1: We use them to prepare what you asked for and to contact you about it. You can ask us to export or delete them at any time at {email}. See the privacy policy for details.

terms.intro: The terms for using crierstudio.com, the monthly packages and the client portal.
terms.who.p: Crier Studio is a design studio for local businesses. Contact us by email at {email} or on WhatsApp at {wa}.
terms.offer.p1: Monthly packages, for one business each, billed monthly: Bronze ({price:seen} a month): {n:seen.posts} social designs with captions, a story with every post and {n:seen.described_reels} reels a month, a monthly content calendar, {plat:seen} platforms and {c:seen.revision_rounds:round} per piece. Silver ({price:visible} a month): {n:visible.posts} social designs with captions, a story with every post and {n:visible.described_reels} reels a month, a monthly content calendar, {plat:visible} platforms and {c:visible.revision_rounds:round} per piece. Gold ({price:growing} a month): {n:growing.posts} social designs with captions, a story with every post and {n:growing.described_reels} reels a month, a monthly content calendar, {plat:growing} platforms and {c:growing.revision_rounds:round} per piece. Diamond ({price:diamond} a month): {n:diamond.posts} social designs with captions, a story with every post and {n:diamond.described_reels} reels a month, a monthly content calendar, {plat:diamond} platforms and {c:diamond.revision_rounds:round} per piece. Every package includes all three platforms (Instagram, Facebook and TikTok); we publish on your pages and reply to comments and messages; and your brand look (colours, fonts, post templates) is set up in your first month and used on every post. The work is made from what you tell us about your business, using your existing logo and the materials you approve.
terms.nopromise.p: We do not promise more customers, more sales, a search ranking or any other result. What we deliver is what is described on the pricing page. What happens next depends on your business, your market and what you do with it.
terms.need.p: Accurate details, and only photos, logos and text you have the right to use. Nothing is published on your pages before you approve it.
terms.pub.p: Every package includes publishing and replies. For this you give us access to your Instagram, Facebook and TikTok pages, and you can remove that access at any time. We publish only posts you have approved. Our team reads and handles the comments and messages on your pages. Questions about health, complaints or refunds are passed to you to answer.
terms.public.p: We review your site and profiles and, for comparisons, public information about similar businesses. If we cannot find comparable businesses we say so. Numbers come from public sources and can be incomplete or out of date.
terms.own.h: Ownership of what we make for you
terms.own.p: The posts, captions and other files we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours. The examples on this site are made for fictional businesses.
terms.refund.p: Monthly packages are not refunded once a month has been paid. You can cancel at any time before your next month starts, and nothing renews automatically. If you are not happy with a design, ask for a change within your package's revision rounds. See the refund policy.
terms.limits.p: We provide our services as described on this site. We do our best to be accurate, but public information we rely on can be incomplete or out of date, so check each post before you approve it. Questions about these terms: {email}.
privacy.intro: What Crier Studio collects when you subscribe to a monthly package on crierstudio.com, message us or use the client portal, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and how to export or erase it.
privacy.collect.p1: This site has no forms. You reach us on WhatsApp or by email, or by creating a client portal account, and the sections below say what we receive through each. By email, we receive your email address and what you write to us.
privacy.collect.p2: We do not use advertising cookies on this site. Analytics cookies are set only if you accept them (see Google Analytics and cookies below).
privacy.wa.p: When you message us on WhatsApp, we receive your phone number, the name on your WhatsApp profile and what you send us, including payment receipts. WhatsApp is a service of Meta Platforms, which handles these messages under its own terms. We use them only to answer you, set up your package and confirm your payment.
privacy.why.p: To prepare the work in your package, to run your client portal account, and to contact you about it on WhatsApp or by email. We do not send you messages you did not ask for, and we do not sell your details.
privacy.who.p: Crier Studio and the people who prepare its work. We use service providers to run the service; they include the following. Railway hosts the client portal and our records system. GitHub Pages hosts this site. Cloudflare handles the domain and, if we switch it on, Cloudflare Web Analytics, a visit counter that does not use cookies. Google (Google LLC) provides Google Analytics, described below. Proton hosts our team@crierstudio.com mailbox, where your emails to us arrive. Resend sends the emails the client portal sends you. Payments go through our payment provider: you enter your card details on the provider's own payment page, so we never see or store your full card number, and the provider tells us your name, your email address, what you bought, the amount and whether the payment went through. The hosts and Cloudflare may see ordinary visit data such as the page viewed and the address of your connection. We give each provider only what its job needs, and we share your details outside the service providers we use only if the law requires it.
privacy.who.p.eg: Crier Studio and the people who prepare its work. We use service providers to run the service; they include the following. Railway hosts the client portal and our records system. GitHub Pages hosts this site. Cloudflare handles the domain and, if we switch it on, Cloudflare Web Analytics, a visit counter that does not use cookies. Google (Google LLC) provides Google Analytics, described below. Meta Platforms provides WhatsApp, where we talk with you and receive your payment receipts. Proton hosts our team@crierstudio.com mailbox, where your emails to us arrive. Resend sends the emails the client portal sends you. Payments are made by InstaPay from your own bank account: we see only the transfer we receive and the receipt you send us (the name, amount, date and reference on it), never your bank sign-in details. The hosts and Cloudflare may see ordinary visit data such as the page viewed and the address of your connection. We give each provider only what its job needs, and we share your details outside the service providers we use only if the law requires it.
privacy.where.p: Some of the services we use are based in the United States, so your details may be processed there. They include Google (site analytics, only if you accept it), Railway (hosting of the client portal and our records system), Resend (email) and our payment provider. Each service protects the data it holds under its own terms. We send a service only what it needs.
privacy.where.p.eg: Some of the services we use are based outside Egypt, mainly in the United States, so your details may be processed there. They include Google (site analytics, only if you accept it), Meta Platforms (WhatsApp), Railway (hosting of the client portal and our records system) and Resend (email). Each service protects the data it holds under its own terms. We send a service only what it needs.
privacy.law.h: Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt
privacy.law.p: If you are in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates or Egypt, your rights over your personal data also come from your country's data protection law: Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law, the UAE's Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data, and Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020. You can ask us at any time what we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it, by email.
privacy.law.p.eg: We work with businesses in Egypt, so your rights over your personal data come from Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020. You can ask us at any time what we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it, by email.
privacy.keep.p: We keep your chats, payment receipts and files for as long as we need them to run the service and keep records of it. Client portal data is kept while your account is open. You can ask us at any time to delete your data, by email or on WhatsApp.
privacy.del.p: Email {email} from the address you used. You can ask us for a copy of the details we hold about you, ask us to correct them, or ask us to erase them. We will send the copy, or confirm the erasure, by email.
privacy.changes.p: If we change this policy, the date above will change. We will not use your details in a new way without asking you first.

consent.label: Cookie choice
consent.text: We use Google Analytics to see which pages are useful. Allow analytics cookies?
privacy.ga.p1: We use Google Analytics 4, a service of Google LLC, to see which pages of this site help visitors. It records the pages you visit and how you reached them, your approximate location (country and city, worked out from your connection's address) and your device, browser and screen size. Google Analytics 4 does not store your IP address. Google's advertising features are switched off, so this data is not used for ads. Google may process it in the United States and keeps it for the period set in our account, at most 14 months.
privacy.ga.p2: Google Analytics sets cookies only after you choose Accept in the cookie bar. Until you choose, or if you choose Decline, it sets no cookies; Google then receives only signals without cookies (for example, that a page was viewed) that carry no cookie identifier. Your choice is saved in your browser. To change it, use the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page, or clear this site's data in your browser and the bar will ask again.
